svg.title: APEX 06 — Which material, for which persona
svg.text: Sixteen pieces of sales and education material, mapped to the six personas. A filled mark means the
material is built for that persona; a ring means it supports the conversation. Build primary materials first.

g.text: Honesty rules: case studies are created only after a pilot report the customer agrees to publish. The ROI calculator uses the customer’s
own baselines and shows no default results. Interactive demos use the built-in demo modes with sample data, labelled as illustrative.

svg.text: Build first: product overview, executive infographic, business value presentation, persona demo videos, technical
overview with security brief, and the pilot proposal. These cover every persona at the first three funnel stages.
Capability status shown on the poster where relevant
Readiness: capabilities marked LIVE are built and tested; none is yet proven in a customer production environment. No customer results, ROI, certifications or prices are claimed.
November 2026 · Internal sales enablement · A0 841 × 1189 mm
